todos: [P2] FULLTASK-RELIABILITY-01: FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01 is closed (2026-09-24): scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b reached completionStatus 'verified' in runs 15, 17 and 22 (8/8 in 28 and 34 steps, build first, then npm test). The closure is not yet reliable: of runs 17-26 after the fixes, 2 closed verified. Failure classes, each seen once, all addressed in code but not yet rerun: run 24 the model called ask about dependency versions and AUTO mode ended the run (fixed 2026-09-24: AUTO answers version questions from the npm registry and the manifest, versionQuestion.ts and AgentToolExecutorService.answerVersionQuestion, sharing the ask redirect budget); run 26 Vitest 0.26 printed only chai's one-line message with a truncated received value (fixed: expected/received read from that message, testedModuleText fallback); run 25 a CssSyntaxError under [plugin vite:css] (now diagnosed); run 21 the auto-matched tailwind-css-v4 skill contradicted a tailwindcss ^3 manifest (fixed: skillVersionFit.ts). Next, on Windows with Ollama, rerun npm run test:live (fullTaskRun.live.ts) until at least 3 of 5 runs close verified, reading the new coding_agent_audit.unredacted.log of each snapshot.

[P2] GPTOSS-FULLTASK-01: gpt-oss:20b plans and runs the full task (GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01 fixed: structured requests of level-only models send think 'low') but still ends 0/10. Fixed on 2026-09-24: shell reads run as read_file (shellFileRead.ts), every turn exposing run_command also exposes read_file, skills named <package>-v<major> leave the prompt once the manifest declares another major, and (after run 5) read_file on a directory lists it and read_file on a missing file returns [FILE NOT FOUND: …] with the parent directory listing as a result, not an execution failure (readFileTool.ts), so run 5's stop at step 15 on the execution recovery budget cannot recur that way. Open, not yet rerun: the model re-reads every file right after writing it (run 5 steps 2, 5, 9, 12); run 4 ended at step 41 on 'Ollama chat stream stalled: no tokens received for 30s' twice while the fast test suite was running on the same machine. Next, rerun with ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b on an idle Windows machine with Ollama and classify the next stop.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log entries carry `localized` (keys of shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, whose AGENT_MAIN_TEXT_IT is also the renderer's `agentMain` Italian locale); Main emits them with emitLocalizedLog (agentOrchestratorTypes.ts). Migrated: the closure summary, reason and 'Diagnostica sessione' entry, and on 2026-09-25 the milestone, plan, loop and circuit-breaker messages of agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts, agentOrchestratorAskAutoHealing.ts, agentOrchestratorFinishAndLoopGuards.ts, agentOrchestratorToolGates.ts and agentOrchestratorTurnDispatch.ts; renderer reactions read the key, not the text (the error sound in useCodingAgentExecution.ts). The agent:done summary stays Italian on purpose (no UI shows it; add AgentDoneResult.localized only with a UI that does). Still fixed-language in the UI: about 25 emitLog messages in agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, agentOrchestratorResponseInterpreter.ts, the cancellation summary in agentOrchestratorTurnDispatch.ts, agentOrchestratorAppService.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionState.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionWatchdog.ts, agentOrchestratorPlanTool.ts and the commit lines of agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts (several are English), the tool result messages built by agentToolExecutorService (toolRes.logMessage), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...', and the session tracker markdown (sessionDebtTracker.ts). Keep the texts the renderer parses: '❓ AI Agent Question:' and 'Task Finished:' (AgentTimelineMessage.tsx strips them), 'Consulting LLM (<model>)' (getStepModelName reads the model from it) and 'Loop' in loop banners. The Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors and waits for a re-index migration. Next, migrate agentOrchestratorResponseInterpreter.ts and agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, then the tool result messages.

[P3] AGENT-GUARD-GROWTH-01: electron/core/domain/agent holds ~60 modules (9.8k lines) and the agentOrchestrator* phases ~8k lines; most guards and directives were added one per failure class seen in live runs. guardEvents already records every firing. Next, report per-guard firing counts across live runs and retire guards that never fire or never change the outcome, before adding new ones.

[P3] SHELL-PATHS-01: commands run through three mechanisms: node-pty in taskRunner.executePowerShellCommand, its child_process fallback when node-pty fails to load or spawn, and PersistentPowerShellSession for the agent tools. Next, decide on one mechanism for the agent and the UI terminal and remove the others.
